base.caveat: DriveLM-nuScenes' challenge val/test answers are withheld behind EvalAI. This split instead partitions DriveLM's answered train file by the official nuScenes v1.0-trainval scene lists (700 train / 150 val) — the canonical published nuScenes partition, applied scene-clean. It is NOT the DriveLM leaderboard split.
